title: Migration saga runner + snapshot guard for Private upgrades
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Implement a resilient upgrade orchestration primitive for Redwood Private that runs multi-step migrations as transactional sagas with snapshot guards. This ticket builds the 'Migration Saga Runner' and associated safety subsystems: preflight validation, immutable snapshot creation for DB and KV layers, binary compatibility checks, LTS-channel-aware configuration adapter, rollout gate DSL, and automated rollback graph generation. The goal is zero-downtime or graceful-degradation upgrades for VPC/on-prem customers with predictable rollback and strong auditability.
acceptance_criteria: Saga runner can execute a 4-step upgrade plan (prepare, schema-migrate, data-migrate, switch) with explicit compensating actions for each step
Preflight checks block an upgrade if schema diffs or binary compatibility mismatches are detected and produce a human-readable report
Immutable snapshot artifacts (DB snapshot + KV export) are produced and verifiable before any destructive step and stored with signatures for audit trails
Rollout gate DSL supports at least: metric-based gate (error-rate, p95 latency), time-window gate, and manual approval; gates can be composed into a pipeline
Canary cohort traffic-shift automation exists and can shift 1%, 5%, 25% with automated rollback on gate failures
Upgrade simulation harness can replay real traffic traces against the migration plan to surface errors before customer rollout
Audit log entries capture step start/finish, artifacts created (with links), user approvals, and automatic rollbacks
End-to-end test in CI that runs the saga runner against a lightweight emulated on-prem cluster and verifies rollback on injected failure
tasks: Design saga execution model and compensating action interface
Implement snapshot-creation service with signing and retention policy
Write LTS channel adapter to map runtime versions to compatible migration strategies
Build rollout gate DSL and evaluation engine
Integrate metric hooks (console telemetry) for automated gate evaluation
Create simulation harness and integrate with perf traces
End-to-end CI job and smoke tests

Nora Liu (PM): Add a lightweight 'fast path' upgrade that uses compatibility-map to skip full data migrations where safe.
Jamal Ortiz (Security): For on-prem installs, ensure signing keys can be customer-managed (bring-your-own-key) — include KMS/HSM integration in design.
SRE: Add telemetry-backed SLO guards into rollout gates (prevent >0.5% error growth over baseline); define how long to wait before a gate times out.
Lucas Martinez: Proposing a 'dry-run' mode that performs all checks and snapshot creation but does not perform switch; useful for customer preflight tickets.
